history_policy: system plus last two completed turns and complete current prompt; no prompt slicing
routing: cloud-only; explicit remote model identity, no local-model claims or savings
method: Actual ForensicsOrchestrator, FunctionRanker and every FunctionAnalyzer analysis method; only source/provider I/O injected
success_rule: Scores require complete production output, no analysis errors, valid explicit model ranking and independently sourced function targets joined after prediction. Partial/capped failures stay unscored.
stops: Provider context/JSON/schema failures are recorded; no fabricated results or fallback model
